atoms.exact_source_text: Nodes are not factories.
atoms.normalized_claim: Nodes are not factories.

atoms.exact_source_text: They have condition, season, memory, and recovery.
atoms.normalized_claim: Nodes have condition, season, memory, and recovery.

atoms.exact_source_text: A stripped field, repeatedly disturbed cache, or careless salvage site changes.
atoms.normalized_claim: Example: a stripped field, repeatedly disturbed cache, or careless salvage site changes over time.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony’s relationship with the corridor is ecological and historical, not only extractive.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Colony's relationship with the corridor is ecological and historical, not only extractive.

atoms.exact_source_text: MEET is the shared Register for bounded consequential situations.
atoms.normalized_claim: MEET is the shared Register for bounded consequential situations.

atoms.exact_source_text: In Away Mode, it stages the exact party and allows individual capability, equipment, history, and Exposure to matter.
atoms.normalized_claim: In Away Mode, MEET stages the exact party and allows individual capability, equipment, history, and Exposure to matter.

atoms.exact_source_text: Its grammar differs from Home MEET because its crunch subject differs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away MEET's grammar differs from Home MEET because its crunch subject differs.

atoms.exact_source_text: CONTEST • EVADE • PARLEY • YIELD • WITHDRAW
atoms.normalized_claim: The five contested Away MEET Approaches are Contest, Evade, Parley, Yield, and Withdraw.

atoms.exact_source_text: The five Approaches remain the provisional taxonomy of contested Away MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: The five Approaches remain the provisional taxonomy of contested Away MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: They are always shown in canonical order and greyed rather than hidden when unavailable.
atoms.normalized_claim: The five Approaches are always shown in canonical order and greyed rather than hidden when unavailable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each carries a short situation-specific line that describes what the action means here without revealing exact odds.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Approach carries a short situation-specific line describing what the action means without revealing exact odds.

atoms.exact_source_text: Overcome, resist, hold, break, seize, or endure directly
atoms.normalized_claim: Contest's core relation is to overcome, resist, hold, break, seize, or endure directly.

atoms.exact_source_text: May be grey when the Presence cannot be fought or held.
atoms.normalized_claim: Contest may be grey when the Presence cannot be fought or held.

atoms.exact_source_text: Slip past, flee, hide, distract, or use terrain to avoid the Presence
atoms.normalized_claim: Evade's core relation is to slip past, flee, hide, distract, or use terrain to avoid the Presence.

atoms.exact_source_text: May be grey when the Presence occupies the desired object and cannot be bypassed.
atoms.normalized_claim: Evade may be grey when the Presence occupies the desired object and cannot be bypassed.

atoms.exact_source_text: Trade, ask, bargain, deceive, persuade, or invoke relationship
atoms.normalized_claim: Parley's core relation is to trade, ask, bargain, deceive, persuade, or invoke relationship.

atoms.exact_source_text: May be grey for weather, machinery, or beings that will not speak.
atoms.normalized_claim: Parley may be grey for weather, machinery, or beings that will not speak.

atoms.exact_source_text: Give ground, cargo, claim, time, or priority to preserve something else
atoms.normalized_claim: Yield's core relation is to give ground, cargo, claim, time, or priority to preserve something else.

atoms.exact_source_text: Never removed; makes sacrifice visible.
atoms.normalized_claim: Yield is never removed as an availability, and it makes sacrifice visible.

atoms.exact_source_text: Leave the Node or situation without pursuing its objective
atoms.normalized_claim: Withdraw's core relation is to leave the Node or situation without pursuing its objective.

atoms.exact_source_text: Never removed unless the situation has physically closed escape,
atoms.normalized_claim: Withdraw is never removed unless the situation has physically closed escape.

atoms.exact_source_text: in which case the Encounter must explicitly explain why.
atoms.normalized_claim: If Withdraw is removed due to physically closed escape, the Encounter must explicitly explain why.

atoms.exact_source_text: The party resolves the shared objective as one body: obtain, escape, persuade, protect, pass, or survive.
atoms.normalized_claim: The party resolves the shared objective as one body: obtain, escape, persuade, protect, pass, or survive.

atoms.exact_source_text: Individual fate resolves afterward around the Citizens who accepted responsibility, pressed the situation, protected another, carried the critical object, or were already vulnerable.
atoms.normalized_claim: Individual fate resolves afterward around Citizens who accepted responsibility, pressed the situation, protected another, carried the critical object, or were already vulnerable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Group success does not immunize individuals;
atoms.normalized_claim: Group success does not immunize individuals from harm.

atoms.exact_source_text: individual harm does not automatically erase group success.
atoms.normalized_claim: Individual harm does not automatically erase group success.
